purpose: Overall system design of doc-link: system boundary, operations and their connections, build sequence overview, and common invariants, including the write boundary limited to DLIDs.
summary: System boundary: doc-link handles document IDs, ToC, search, DLID resolution, reference checks, and change-impact candidate notification
Write boundary: only DLIDs are written, in frontmatter and heading line ends, only by the explicit DLID embedding operation
Operations table: inputs, results handed on, and write boundaries for each operation
ToC build order: target fixing, ID check, change detection, info retrieval, reference check, candidate check, commit
Excluded documents with missing or duplicate IDs are reported without stopping the build
Overall sequence diagram of index-docs followed by check-impact as a separate operation
Unreadable reference target directories are recorded as absent without blocking commit
Common invariants: stable document IDs, directory scan before asserting references, no partial candidate exposure, no stored notification state
Updating one key never touches other keys ToC
Pointers to individual designs for storage and multi-key visibility decisions
tasks: Designing or changing a doc-link operation
Checking the write boundary for user documents
Deciding where a new operation fits
title: DES-001 システム全体設計
